title: Raise [parallel] max_concurrency from 1 to 2 in athena.toml
summary: Change the single value max_concurrency in the [parallel] table of athena.toml from 1 to 2 so a batch runs two independent jobs at once. The audience is whoever runs batches. No other file or key changes.

defaults_applied.how: One value changed in one file.
Verifier runs cargo test --locked -p athena-data and checks the diff.
Criteria check the value and the diff scope.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: let a batch run two independent jobs concurrently; the drain supports up to 8 and the disk check holds jobs when disk is low, as the request states.
The max_concurrency key at athena.toml line 195 is the one under [parallel].
Governance file athena.toml is a deliverable and named in the criteria; defaults.toml and workflows need no change.
Code survey: no code change is made; crates/ is not edited, so no behavior beyond the cargo test criterion applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: Grep of athena.toml finds max_concurrency = 2 at the [parallel] table (line about 195) and no line with max_concurrency = 1.
git diff shows athena.toml as the only changed file, with exactly one changed line: max_concurrency = 1 becomes max_concurrency = 2, and no new key.
Run cargo test --locked -p athena-data; it passes.

out_of_scope: Changing the parallel drain code or its maximum of 8
Adding config keys or changing the config schema
departures: Single-value config change; cheaper and faster than the reference, though the cargo test run may be cold-built.
